Note that you also need a carafe to make this much coffee at the time.  I would definitely purchase it again and highly recommend it to all coffee mug owners, and to folks who wish to serve several guests at a time.

I bought this for our cabin as I want a cook stove that I can move off the counter when I am not cooking and can use that space for other things.  This arrived as scheduled but the box it was packaged in was torn all to pieces.  The cooktop is black glass and it was not broken but the metal burner parts were all apart and rattling around in what was left of the box.  It took me a while to figure out how all the parts went together but we finally got it.  It comes with a very cheap, think orange propane hose and a  regulator  and that cheap rubber hose just pushes onto the back of the stovetop and there is a metal clamp on it to tighten down with a screwdriver.  Very cheaply done for a stove top that looks this good.  There is no fitting and no way to put a fitting on the stovetop so the only thing to do is use a better made hose and clamp to put the gas line on the stove.  I wish they have done the inlet fitting better.

Did notice a little discoloration on bottom of pan but that might just be from the new finish/paint on burners. Once the hose is hidden it looks great. And for the reviews that said the regulator would not work with tanks in Tx or Fl look inside the end that screws in the tank and remove the large protective rubber washer. It should work fine then. Mine did. The hose clamp connex are the only reason I didn't give 5 stars.  I've included a photo of the washer that should be removed.
